description: Displays the dependency tree for a Rust project.

charset.description: Character set for tree display (--charset). Use 'ascii' for consistent output regardless of terminal.

depth.description: Maximum depth of the dependency tree to display

duplicates.description: Show only packages that appear more than once in the tree (--duplicates). Useful for detecting version conflicts.

edges.description: Filter dependency edges by kind (--edges <KINDS>). Example: 'normal' to exclude dev/build deps.

features.description: Space or comma separated list of features to activate (--features)

format.description: Custom format string for each package (--format <FMT>). Example: '{p} {l}'

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

invert.description: Invert the tree to show reverse dependencies (--invert <SPEC>). Critical for tracing which crates depend on a given package.

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default feature (--no-default-features)

package.description: Focus on a specific package in the tree

prune.description: Prune the given package from the tree display (--prune <SPEC>). Simplifies output by hiding a specific dependency subtree.

name: tree

dependencies.description: Flat list of dependencies with name, version, and depth

depth.description: Nesting depth in the dependency tree (0 = root)

title: Cargo Tree
